title: The importance of the change-of-variables integration technique in deriving the PDFs of important probability distributions
summary: The purpose of this article is to explicitly describe how the integration technique known as the change of variables is used in graduate-level Probability and Statistics courses. Throughout the article, we employ this integration technique seven times across various examples and results. We demonstrate that four applications of this technique are required to derive the probability density function (PDF) of the Student's t-distribution.
